title: Calculus
tagline: Limits, derivatives, integrals and the mathematics of change.
description: Single-variable calculus made for listening, picking up where the Mathematics path ends. It builds limits and continuity, then the derivative and its rules, the applications of derivatives, the integral and the fundamental theorem of calculus, techniques and applications of integration, differential equations, and sequences and series. Every expression is spoken in words and every worked example is walked through step by step.

modules.title: Functions and Limits Foundations
modules.summary: Learners will understand the foundational concepts of functions and the two core problems that calculus aims to solve.

lessons.title: Functions and Graphs in Words
lessons.summary: Learners will review function behavior and graph descriptions using verbal language instead of visual aids.

lessons.title: The Two Problems of Calculus
lessons.summary: Learners will explore the tangent line problem and the area problem that define the field of calculus.

lessons.title: Intuitive Limits and Tables
lessons.summary: Learners will understand how to estimate the limit of a function using numerical tables of values.

lessons.title: One Sided Limits and Existence
lessons.summary: Learners will determine when a limit exists by comparing the behavior from the left and right sides.

modules.title: Limits and Continuity
modules.summary: Learners will master the calculation of limits and the formal definition of continuity.

lessons.title: Limit Laws and Algebraic Evaluation
lessons.summary: Learners will apply the basic laws of limits and use factoring to resolve indeterminate forms.

lessons.title: The Squeeze Theorem and Sine
lessons.summary: Learners will use the squeeze theorem to find the limit of sine of x over x as x approaches zero.

lessons.title: Continuity and the Intermediate Value
lessons.summary: Learners will define continuity at a point and apply the intermediate value theorem to find roots.

lessons.title: Limits at Infinity and Asymptotes
lessons.summary: Learners will analyze the end behavior of functions and identify horizontal asymptotes.

lessons.title: The Precise Epsilon Delta Definition
lessons.summary: Learners will understand the formal definition of a limit using the language of epsilon and delta.

modules.title: The Derivative
modules.summary: Learners will understand the derivative as a rate of change and apply basic differentiation rules.

lessons.title: The Derivative as a Limit
lessons.summary: Learners will define the derivative as the limit of average rates of change over an interval.

lessons.title: The Derivative as a Function
lessons.summary: Learners will understand how the derivative creates a new function representing the slope at any point.

lessons.title: Power and Constant Multiple Rules
lessons.summary: Learners will apply the power rule and constant multiple rule to find derivatives of polynomials.

lessons.title: Product and Quotient Rules
lessons.summary: Learners will differentiate products and quotients of functions using standardized formulas.

lessons.title: Velocity and Acceleration
lessons.summary: Learners will use derivatives to model the physical motion of objects over time.

modules.title: Differentiation Rules
modules.summary: Learners will apply advanced differentiation rules to trigonometric, exponential, and inverse functions.

lessons.title: Trigonometric Derivatives
lessons.summary: Learners will find the derivatives of the sine, cosine, tangent, and secant functions.

lessons.title: The Chain Rule
lessons.summary: Learners will differentiate composite functions by applying the chain rule step by step.

lessons.title: Implicit Differentiation
lessons.summary: Learners will find the derivative of functions where the dependent variable is not isolated.

lessons.title: Exponential and Natural Logarithm Derivatives
lessons.summary: Learners will differentiate functions involving the natural constant e and the natural logarithm.

lessons.title: Inverse Functions and Inverse Trigonometry
lessons.summary: Learners will find the derivatives of inverse functions and the inverse trigonometric functions.

modules.title: Applications of Derivatives
modules.summary: Learners will use derivatives to solve real-world problems involving rates, optimization, and graph behavior.

lessons.title: Related Rates and Linear Approximation
lessons.summary: Learners will solve problems involving multiple changing variables and use differentials to approximate values.

lessons.title: Maxima, Minima and Extreme Values
lessons.summary: Learners will identify absolute and local extrema using the extreme value theorem.

lessons.title: The Mean Value Theorem
lessons.summary: Learners will understand the relationship between the average rate of change and the instantaneous derivative.

lessons.title: Derivative Tests and Graph Shape
lessons.summary: Learners will use the first and second derivatives to determine concavity and find points of inflection.

lessons.title: Indeterminate Forms and L'Hôpital's Rule
lessons.summary: Learners will use L Hopital's rule to evaluate limits of indeterminate forms like zero over zero.

lessons.title: Optimization and Newton's Method
lessons.summary: Learners will solve optimization problems and use Newtons method to approximate roots of equations.

modules.title: The Integral
modules.summary: Learners will understand the relationship between differentiation and integration through the fundamental theorem.

lessons.title: Antiderivatives and Riemann Sums
lessons.summary: Learners will understand the concept of the antiderivative and the approximation of area using rectangles.

lessons.title: The Definite Integral
lessons.summary: Learners will define the definite integral as the limit of a Riemann sum.

lessons.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
lessons.summary: Learners will understand the dual nature of the theorem and the historical contributions of Newton and Leibniz.

lessons.title: Integration by Substitution
lessons.summary: Learners will use the substitution method to reverse the chain rule during integration.

lessons.title: Exponential and Logarithmic Integrals
lessons.summary: Learners will evaluate integrals that result in natural logarithms or exponential functions.

modules.title: Applications of Integration
modules.summary: Learners will apply integration to calculate areas, volumes, and physical properties like work.

lessons.title: Area Between Curves
lessons.summary: Learners will calculate the area of regions bounded by two or more functions.

lessons.title: Volumes by Slicing and Disks
lessons.summary: Learners will find the volume of solids of revolution using the disk and washer methods.

lessons.title: Volumes by Cylindrical Shells
lessons.summary: Learners will use the shell method to find volumes of revolution around a vertical axis.

lessons.title: Arc Length and Physical Applications
lessons.summary: Learners will calculate the length of a curve and apply integration to find work and mass.

lessons.title: Growth and Decay Revisited
lessons.summary: Learners will use integration to solve problems involving exponential growth and radioactive decay.

modules.title: Techniques of Integration
modules.summary: Learners will master advanced techniques for evaluating complex integrals.

lessons.title: Integration by Parts
lessons.summary: Learners will use the integration by parts formula to evaluate integrals of products.

lessons.title: Trigonometric Integrals and Substitution
lessons.summary: Learners will evaluate integrals involving powers of trigonometric functions and use trigonometric substitution.

lessons.title: Integration by Partial Fractions
lessons.summary: Learners will decompose rational functions into simpler fractions to facilitate integration.

lessons.title: Numerical Integration and Simpson's Rule
lessons.summary: Learners will approximate integrals using the midpoint trapezoidal and Simpsons rules.

lessons.title: Evaluating Improper Integrals
lessons.summary: Learners will determine the convergence of integrals with infinite limits or discontinuous integrands.

modules.title: Differential Equations
modules.summary: Learners will understand how to model change using differential equations and numerical methods.

lessons.title: Introduction to Differential Equations
lessons.summary: Learners will define differential equations and verify solutions to basic initial value problems.

lessons.title: Slope Fields and Euler's Method
lessons.summary: Learners will understand how to visualize and approximate solutions to differential equations.

lessons.title: Solving Separable Equations
lessons.summary: Learners will use the method of separation of variables to solve first order equations.

lessons.title: The Logistic Growth Equation
lessons.summary: Learners will model population growth with carrying capacity using the logistic equation.

lessons.title: First Order Linear Equations
lessons.summary: Learners will solve linear differential equations using an integrating factor.

modules.title: Sequences and Series
modules.summary: Learners will determine the convergence or divergence of infinite sequences and series.

lessons.title: Sequences and Their Limits
lessons.summary: Learners will find the limit of an infinite sequence and determine if it converges.

lessons.title: Infinite Series and Geometric Series
lessons.summary: Learners will understand the sum of an infinite series and the properties of geometric series.

lessons.title: Divergence and Integral Tests
lessons.summary: Learners will use the divergence test and the integral test to check for series convergence.

lessons.title: Comparison and Alternating Series
lessons.summary: Learners will apply comparison tests and the alternating series test to determine convergence.

lessons.title: Ratio and Root Tests
lessons.summary: Learners will use the ratio and root tests to analyze the convergence of complex series.

modules.title: Power Series
modules.summary: Learners will represent functions as infinite power series and use them for approximation.

lessons.title: Power Series and Convergence
lessons.summary: Learners will find the radius and interval of convergence for a power series.

lessons.title: Working with Power Series
lessons.summary: Learners will differentiate and integrate power series to find representations for new functions.

lessons.title: Taylor and Maclaurin Series
lessons.summary: Learners will construct Taylor and Maclaurin series for common transcendental functions.

lessons.title: Using Taylor Series
lessons.summary: Learners will apply Taylor series to approximate functions and estimate the remainder error.

modules.title: Parametric and Polar Curves
modules.summary: Learners will extend calculus to parametric and polar coordinate systems.

lessons.title: Parametric Curves and Motion
lessons.summary: Learners will describe curves defined by parametric equations and find their derivatives.

lessons.title: Calculus with Parametric Curves
lessons.summary: Learners will calculate the area under a parametric curve and its arc length.

lessons.title: Polar Coordinates and Graphs
lessons.summary: Learners will understand the polar coordinate system and describe polar graphs in words.

lessons.title: Polar Area and Calculus
lessons.summary: Learners will use integration to find the area of regions bounded by polar curves.

lessons.title: The Future of Higher Mathematics
lessons.summary: Learners will look ahead to multivariable calculus, linear algebra, and advanced differential equations.
